newsitem.title: USA: Applied Analytical seen opening strong.
newsitem.headline: Applied Analytical seen opening strong.

text.p: Shares of Applied Analytical Industries Inc are expected to open strong at their market debut after their initial public offering, according to analyst Manish Shah of the IPO Maven publication.
"I'd be surprised of they opened below 20," Shah said.

The company is offering 2.7 million shares, which priced at 16 for the offering. Applied Analytical is a contract research organization. Goldman was the lead underwriter of the offering. Shah noted that two similar firms that have gone public in the past two years, Quintiles Transnational Corp and Parexel International Corp have both more than doubled in value.
